abilities.effect: For each target: • Make a pile-in move. • Then, pick an enemy unit in combat with the target and roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on that enemy unit equal to the roll.

abilities.name: Claw-picked

abilities.declare: Pick up to 3 friendly Verminus units that charged this turn to be the targets.
abilities.effect: Add 1 to the Rend characteristic of the targets' melee weapons for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Will of the Horned Rat

abilities.name: Backstabbing Allies

abilities.effect: Pick up to 2 other friendly Skaven units that are not in combat and are wholly within 13" of the unit using the 'Redeploy' command to be the targets. Each target must have at least one of the following keywords: Verminus, Skryre, Moulder, Pestilens, Eshin. After that 'Redeploy' command has been resolved, each of the targets can immediately use the 'Redeploy' command in an order of your choice without any command points being spent.
